title: C: Min Heap
description: Implement a min-heap data structure using an array with insert and extract-min operations.

steps.title: Min Heap Operations
steps.description: Define a `Heap` struct with int array, size, and capacity. Implement `void heap_push(Heap *h, int val)` and `int heap_pop(Heap *h)` (returns the minimum). Test by inserting 5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2 and extracting all.
hints: Push: add at end, then bubble up.
Pop: swap root with last, remove last, bubble down.
